notes.title: [Alpha Update 1.2]
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Stamina recovery has been increased by 60%
[*] The quest order has been improved to reduce quest stuttering, the purple berries are now being counted for the berry eating quest and the fish are now back for the swimming with the fish quest
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Characters now cannot be attacked anymore during login
[*] Opening/closing doors is now working properly again
[*] Players getting stuck when laying down in the slouched stance fixed
[/list]
